theme.title: Past Meets Present

funFacts.text: Boston sold out every regular-season home game during its dramatic turnaround.

funFacts.text: Kevin Garnett brought a defensive identity that earned him Defensive Player of the Year.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Kevin Garnett was named NBA Defensive Player of the Year

funFacts.text: The architect of the new Big Three, Danny Ainge, earned Executive of the Year honors.

questions.prompt: How many seconds does an NBA team have to shoot under the shot clock?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The NBA has had a 24-second limit since 1954.

funFacts.text: Danny Biasone and Leo Ferris first tested the shot-clock idea at a Syracuse Nationals scrimmage.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Danny Biasone and general manager Leo Ferris experimented with a 24-second shot clock during a scrimmage

funFacts.text: Biasone arrived at the timing by counting shot attempts in basketball's most entertaining games.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: I noticed each team took about 60 shots. That meant 120 shots per game.

funFacts.text: Before the rule, teams protecting a lead could stall endlessly by passing without shooting.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Teams in the lead were running out the clock, passing the ball incessantly

questions.prompt: Allen Iverson handed the 2001 Lakers their only playoff loss in Finals Game 1. How many points did he score?
questions.context: 2001 NBA Finals · Game 1 · at Los Angeles

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Iverson scored 48 points along with 5 steals

funFacts.text: Iverson's overtime step-back over Tyronn Lue produced the famous image of him stepping over his fallen defender.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: he stepped over Lue after hitting the shot

funFacts.text: Philadelphia survived despite trailing early, after Los Angeles opened with a long unanswered scoring run.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Scoring 16 straight points, the Lakers took a 21–9 lead

funFacts.text: Dikembe Mutombo's interior work helped Philadelphia hang on as a late missed shot sent the game to overtime.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: when Dikembe Mutombo missed two free throws and Eric Snow's desperation three-pointer

questions.prompt: The 2007 Finals sweep set what was then a record-low TV rating. What was it?
questions.context: 2007 NBA Finals · Spurs vs Cavaliers · ABC

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: San Antonio's four-game sweep of Cleveland finished with a record-low 6.2 television rating and 11 share on ABC

funFacts.text: Cleveland was appearing in its first NBA Finals, as was its young superstar LeBron James.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: This was Cleveland's first trip to the NBA Finals in their franchise history

funFacts.text: San Antonio guard Tony Parker earned Finals MVP after the Spurs swept Cleveland.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Tony Parker was named the series' MVP

funFacts.text: The 2007 championship series was the last four-game Finals sweep until 2018, also featuring Cleveland.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: This series was the last sweep in the NBA Finals until 2018

questions.prompt: Seattle won the 1979 title. What did its top scorer, Gus Williams, average in the Finals?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Gus Williams of the SuperSonics was the top scorer, averaging 28.6 points per game

funFacts.text: Dennis Johnson, not Williams, won Finals MVP for the SuperSonics' title run.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Dennis Johnson of the SuperSonics was named as the NBA Finals MVP

funFacts.text: Seattle's triumph avenged a Finals defeat to the same Washington Bullets team the previous year.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The series was a rematch of the previous year's NBA Finals, which the Bullets won

funFacts.text: Before the SuperSonics won, Seattle's last men's major professional sports title came in ice hockey.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Seattle Metropolitans' victory in the 1917 Stanley Cup Final
